skills.skill_desc:
Khufra activates the <font color="a6aafb">Spell Curse</font> left by Esmeralda every 8s, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> (+ 6% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. He also slows the target by 30% for 1.5s and recovers 8% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font> on hit.

Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Spell Curse</font> is reduced by 4s.

Khufra pulls the bandages on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing 50 (+ 7<font color="fba51f"> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to all enemies on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering the first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50 (+ 7<font color="fba51f"> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for up to 1s.

Khufra uses bandages to wrap himself into a <font color="a6aafb">Bouncing Ball</font>, increasing his <font color="26e407"><1999></font> by 30%. Enemies trying to use mobility skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne.

Each time the <font color="a6aafb">Bouncing Ball</font> hits the ground, it deals 50 (+ 3<font color="fba51f"> (+2% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slows them by 80% for 0.2s.

Khufra pushes back all enemy targets around him toward his front (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them down for 1.25s. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.
